environment.description: Same application deployed on ECS Fargate behind an ALB. The ALB has an associated AWS WAF v2 WebACL with the following rule groups evaluated in order: (1) AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet with SizeRestrictions_QUERYSTRING rule in COUNT mode, (2) a custom rule group 'inventory-api-controls' containing a RegexPatternSet match condition on all QueryString components using pattern '(?i)(union|select|case\s+when|substr|hex\(|randomblob|char\(|order\s+by\s+\(|,\s*\(select)' with action BLOCK and priority 1, (3) a rate-based rule at 100 requests per 5 minutes per IP. Additionally, the ECS task role has an IAM permission boundary that denies ssm:GetParameter and secretsmanager:GetSecretValue (irrelevant to SQLi but present). The Fargate task runs with a read-only root filesystem except /var/data mount.

config.network: private subnets, ALB in public subnets
